documents.license_notes: Public policy notified in the Gazette of India on 31 October 2007. Excerpted from government-sourced summaries reproduced in Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha answers (eparlib.nic.in) and public policy portals (indiaenvironmentportal.org.in), since the original Gazette PDF was not reachable from this environment (see README limitations).

note: Minimum bar per DATA_SOURCES.md was 3-5 real documents; this corpus intentionally covers three hazard/response angles (landslides, floods, the overarching NDMP) plus the resettlement policy most directly relevant to relocation reasoning, so RELOCATION-type queries have real grounding, not just hazard guidance.
